announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results follow the Sodales AI investment completion in September and the recent loan facility drawdown.

announcements.headline: Completion of Strategic Investment in Sodales Al
announcements.insight: The strategic investment announced in July is now complete. This follows the earlier drawdown of a US$5 million loan facility in August.

announcements.headline: US$5 million Unsecured Loan Facility Drawdown
announcements.insight: The loan facility drawdown follows the July strategic investment in Sodales AI, likely funding this expansion. Shareholders should monitor how this capital deployment impacts future performance.

announcements.headline: Strategic Investment in Sodales AI
announcements.insight: GSTechnologies NPV (DI) announces a strategic investment in Sodales AI. This follows the June 2026 Semnet Update, suggesting continued operational development.

announcements.headline: Semnet Update
announcements.insight: Semnet Update provides a status report on GSTechnologies' operations. Shareholders should monitor future filings for material developments.
